title: stenocarpus umbellifer
intro: Stenocarpus umbellifer, commonly known as the Umbrella Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Stemonuraceae. It is native to Australia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Stenocarpus umbellifer include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
